summary: Dynagas LNG Partners LP filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated May 8, 2026, announcing a quarterly cash distribution of $0.050 per common unit for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The distribution is payable on May 22, 2026 to holders of record as of May 18, 2026. The filing contains no transaction, stake change, premium, advisor, or structural mechanics. It is a routine dividend announcement by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
